adjudication.rationale: The diff shows `TopicRetriever#perform_retrieve` synchronously calling `Jobs::PollFeed.new.execute({})` when `SiteSetting.feed_polling_enabled?` is true (lib/topic_retriever.rb). `Jobs::PollFeed#poll_feed` performs a full `open(SiteSetting.feed_polling_url)` and iterates all items to `TopicEmbed.import`, and there is no last-modified/ETag/sentinel check anywhere in the shown code. Also, `Jobs::PollFeed#feed_key` is defined but never referenced in this diff, so any intended “modified” tracking isn’t implemented. This is a concrete perf/architecture issue (extra feed downloads/work in the retrieve path and potentially longer Sidekiq job runtimes), but it’s not a strictly correctness-breaking defect. Note: it’s not literally “on every embed hit” due to `retrieved_recently?` throttling per `@embed_url` (60s), but it can still cause repeated full feed downloads for URLs not in the feed.
